basic_details.job_title: NFDC Senior Executive Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is up to 35 years.

qualification.details: 5 years of relevant experience in project coordination, media and communication, event management, or the media and entertainment sector, with exposure to stakeholder coordination, documentation, procurement/tender processes, financial coordination, reporting and record management. Experience in media planning, content development and coordination of large-scale events or government/institutional projects will be desirable.

salary_details.details: The remuneration is a consolidated monthly amount of Rs. 70,000/- per month all inclusive.

how_to_apply: Visit the NFDC LinkedIn Portal on or before 16 October 2026 till 6:00 pm.
Fill up the application form with all required details.
Submit the application form through the portal before the closing time.
Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this post?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by National Film Development Corporation Ltd. (NFDC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Senior Executive (NFDC-WAVES).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to fill up the application form is 16/10/2026 till 6:00 pm.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree, with a desired education in Post Graduation Degree in Media and Communication or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 70,000/- per month all inclusive.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates apply?
faq.answer: Candidates may fill up the application form on the NFDC LinkedIn Portal.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee mentioned in the notice?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis for a period of one year at Regional Office Delhi.
